name: season-north-rest
description: Automatic season factor (C10), northern hemisphere in December: a let_top_dry plant with I=7 and rest factor 1.5 waits 11 days.
why: PROVISIONAL. Rest season is November to February (north) and May to August (south), taken from the date of the last watering. 7 x 1.5 = 10.5 rounds half up to 11; band [8,14] from 2026-12-01 gives 12-09 to 12-15.
